Subject: MAP orchestration & acceptance criteria — Helio Diagnostics POC

Hi Asha,

Thanks for the time earlier. Per our conversation I wanted to kick off a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the POC/evaluation so we have clear owners, measurable acceptance criteria, and a tight timeline toward a decision. I attached a short MAP template and a redacted sample payload to help jump-start the bench.

Proposed high-level acceptance criteria (please confirm/adjust):
- Functional correctness: intent/classification match >= 88% on the 200-case benchmark set you shared (top-1).
- Hallucination threshold: < 5% of outputs require manual correction on a random 100-case audit.
- Latency: 95th percentile <= 600ms for 512-token equivalent requests in your dev region.
- Throughput: sustain 120 concurrent sessions with a median per-request wall-time < 250ms for short-form queries.
- Cost target: average inference cost per 1k tokens <= our agreed proforma (we'll model once sample traffic is shared).

Benchmark plan (high level):
1) Week 0 (this week): finalize dataset slices, NDA/Security list, and owners.
2) Week 1: Redwood runs baseline against two model configs + quantized variant on dev corpus.
3) Week 2: Helio reviews outputs, we run a 1000-case smoke test, and capture latency/cost.
4) Week 3: Joint review, tweak prompts, roll additional prompt variants, and finalize acceptance sign-off checklist.

Owners (proposed):
- Prompt & eval bench technical lead: Ben Carter (Redwood SE)
- Customer success / acceptance steward: Marissa Cole (Redwood CSM)
- Commercial agreement / timelines: Jordan Blake (Redwood AE)
- Contract & entitlements: Priyom Das (Redwood Partnerships)

Open asks for Helio:
- Confirm the primary POC stakeholders (product, security, procurement).
- Share the redacted sample payloads (or confirm the attached is representative).
- Indicate any data residency / encryption requirements we should model in the private environment.

I attached: helio_map_template_v1.xlsx (MAP skeleton), helio_sample_payloads_redacted.json, and our redwood-security-summary.pdf.

Can we schedule a 45-minute MAP kickoff this week to align owners and lock the calendar for the bench runs? I have availability Tue/Wed 9:30–12:00 PT.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this.

—
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
